title: Staged RDS durable outbox event
description: Notification data, never execution permission or scientific certification. Runtime also enforces canonical UTF-8 size <=65536 bytes, payload depth <=32, matching ledger attempt and contiguous per-attempt sequence.

job_id.description: Existing ProjectStore run ID; runtime permits only Unicode alphanumeric, hyphen and underscore.

payload.description: Immutable JSON evidence object. Existing evidence validators remain the caller's responsibility.
